title: The Daily Grind – Peach Green Tea Lemonade 100ML
description:
The Daily Grind – Peach Green Tea Lemonade 100ML
Get ahead of the daily grind with an invigorating selection of coffee house vape juice. Every bit as creamy and delicious as the real thing, these fresh cafe-style flavours are developed in the UK, produced in Australia.
A wonderful green tea, blended with lemons and juicy peaches, topped up with ice. A patio-ready refreshment fit for any true lover of all things sweet.
Primary Flavours
: Peach, Green Tea, Lemonade
PG/VG Ratio:
70 VG / 30 PG
Bottle Sizes:
100ml
Nicotine:
0 MG
